notes: State department lists sourced from official portals: tn.gov.in department_list.php / dept_profile.php (secretary names live-scraped from each department's official profile page); kerala.gov.in Secretaries directory (subdetail page, updated 25-Sep-2026 per site footer) cross-referenced against kerala.gov.in Secretariat Departments listing; py.gov.in /department (48-department Directorates list, updated 21-Sep-2026) and /secretaries directory. headPositionId assigned by matching each department's live-portal minister/portfolio name against the minister holders + portfolio notes already in states-tn-kl-py.json; where no named minister's portfolio text matched a department, headPositionId falls back to the Chief Minister position per that state's existing note that the CM 'holds ... other portfolios not allocated to other ministers' (flagged confidence: medium on those entities). Kerala and Puducherry lack a per-department 'official URL'; used the general portal/secretariat page instead. TN's 'Agriculture', 'Legislative Assembly' and 'Public (Elections)' departments, and Kerala's 'Law', 'Minority Welfare' and 'Drugs Control'-adjacent PY departments (Law, Police, Prisons, Ayush, Drugs Control, Food and Drugs Testing, Food Safety, Accounts and Treasuries) have no secretary name published on the source pages as of the as-of date, so no secretary Position was created for them (omitted rather than guessed, per instructions). PY Police is constitutionally a subject the Lieutenant Governor (not the elected government) has a strong role in under Puducherry's UT arrangement; its headPositionId (Home Minister) reflects conventional department grouping on py.gov.in, not a confirmed political-control fact — treat with caution.

verification.method: Structural validation via local script (ID-format, duplicate-id, headPositionId/adminHeadPositionId/orgId resolution, relation from/to resolution, required-field, vacant/holder-consistency checks) + live re-fetch of primary sources via WebFetch (WebSearch quota for the session was already exhausted by other agents, so live official pages were fetched directly instead): tn.gov.in/department_list.php + 8 tn.gov.in/dept_profile.php pages, kerala.gov.in Secretaries directory (subdetail page), py.gov.in/secretaries and py.gov.in/department.

structuralChecks.note: All entity/position ids matched the st-<code>-dept-* / st-<code>-pos-secretary-* patterns with no duplicates. Every headPositionId resolved (against this file plus data/raw/states-tn-kl-py.json). Relation 'type' values used ('heads', 'oversees') are NOT in SCHEMA.md's enum of relation types (closest valid analogue is 'administers') -- flagged but left unchanged because this convention is used identically and consistently across all 9 data/raw/state-depts-*.json sibling segments, so a unilateral rename in only this file would desynchronize it from the rest of the dataset; this is a dataset-wide convention decision that needs to be made once, not per-segment.

sourcesUsed: https://www.tn.gov.in/dept_profile.php?dep_id=<base64 dept id> (8 TN departments individually re-fetched: Home, Finance, Revenue, Health, School Education, Rural Development, Energy, Industries)

https://kerala.gov.in/subdetail/MTIzOTc2NzU2LjY0/MTk5NjIzNTkuMTI= (Kerala Secretaries directory, re-fetched twice -- once in English, once specifically checked for Malayalam-only entries the first pass missed)

corrections.reason: kerala.gov.in Secretaries directory lists 'Shri Shanavaz S. IAS' for Local Self-Government (Special Secretary) as a distinct officer from Anupama T V, who is separately and explicitly listed only for Transport. The original entry's own notes field ('Also handles: Sri Shanavas S IAS') already contained the correct name but it had been attached to the wrong department/holder pairing.

confirmedCorrect: st-kl-pos-secretary-social-justice (Abdul Nazar B) -- initially looked like a stale duplicate of the Fisheries secretary, but a second, targeted re-fetch of the Malayalam-language portion of the same directory page confirmed 'Shri Abdul Naser B IAS' explicitly holds Social Justice as an additional charge alongside Fisheries. No change made.

st-kl-pos-secretary-public-works (Adeela Abdulla) -- an initial English-only page summary garbled this to 'Adeel Abdullah' (wrong gender/spelling); a second fetch of the same page's Malayalam text confirmed 'Dr. Adeela Abdulla IAS' matches the existing JSON exactly. No change made.

departmentListCompletenessCheck.st-tn: 42/42 departments verified to match tn.gov.in/department_list.php exactly (live re-fetch, same order, same names). All checklist portfolios present (several combined, e.g. Rural Development and Panchayat Raj is one department). Note: Tamil Nadu's official site does NOT currently list a standalone 'Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department' -- that subject now appears consolidated under 'Social Justice Department' on the live site, confirmed by the live fetch, so nothing was added (the source itself does not have it as a separate department).
departmentListCompletenessCheck.st-kl: 49/49 matches the segment's own raw official-source scrape (kl_departments.json, itself sourced from kerala.gov.in's Secretariat Departments listing per the segment's notes); all checklist portfolios present, several combined per Kerala's actual Secretariat structure (e.g. Local Self Government Department covers both rural and urban local government).
departmentListCompletenessCheck.st-py: 48/48 verified to match py.gov.in/department's Directorates list exactly (live re-fetch of the underlying raw scrape confirms no additions/removals needed). All checklist portfolios present; PWD covers water resources (Puducherry has no standalone Water Resources directorate). The py.gov.in/secretaries page additionally lists a few officer-level charges (e.g. 'Sports & Youth Affairs', 'General Administration', 'Excise') that are NOT separate Directorates on py.gov.in/department, so they were correctly not added as department entities -- they are sub-portfolios of the Directorates already present.

verification.notChanged: Left the 'heads'/'oversees' non-schema relation-type naming as-is (see structuralChecks note above -- systemic across all state-depts-*.json segments, out of scope for a single-segment fix). Did not add adminHeadPositionId to the 139 department entities even though the secretary Position ids could technically populate it (schema marks this field optional and the task scope was verification/correction, not schema enrichment).
